item.title: Stephen Thompson MBE, to Step Down as Managing Director and from the Club’s Board of Directors as of the 31st March 2026.
item.description: Following the announcement of the takeover of Dagenham & Redbridge Football Club by the Happy Fan Group, Stephen Thompson MBE has decided to step down from his role as Managing Director and his position on the Club’s Board of Directors. The post Stephen Thompson MBE, to Step Down as Managing Director and from the Club’s Board of Directors as of the 31st March 2026. appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: GLOBAL SUPERSTAR KSI JOINS DAGENHAM & REDBRIDGE FC AS SHAREHOLDER AND STRATEGIC PARTNER
item.description: Dagenham & Redbridge FC is thrilled to announce its most significant strategic partnership to date: Olajide Olayinka Williams Olatunji, known globally as KSI, has officially joined the club as a shareholder and strategic partner.
